unconfirmedFirstMessage.message:
------This is an automated message, please do not reply------

Dear {{guest_first}}, sorry for the delay, I will be with you as soon as possible! If you don't require a response, please kindly ignore this message.

Please note that our office hours are between 9AM-6PM, Monday – Friday. Delays in response outside of this timeframe and on the weekends may be expected. 

If you have not received a response yet, please check out our frequently asked questions (FAQ) below:

**FAQ - Frequently Asked Questions**

Q1. Can I early check-in or late check-out?
A1. Early check-in requests are subject to the previous day's availability, please contact us on the day of check-in to check availability. Alternatively, you may book 1 day ahead of your check-in date to guarantee an early check-in. Late check-out requests are only available until 11AM if approved, please contact us directly to arrange this.
 
Q2. Luggage Drop Off - Can I drop off my luggage before check-in or store my luggage to collect later after check-out?
A2. This depends on whether you have booked for a private room, or for the whole house. If you have booked for a private room, we have chain-locks available in the common area with keys attached, please feel free to use this if you require luggage storage. If you have booked for a full house, we do not currently have any storage facilities for luggage storage.
 
Q3. Will there be anyone to receive me once I arrive?
A3. No - This is a self-check-in property, we will send you check-in instructions on how to access the property. We only provide online reception.
 
Q4. Where is your property address located?
A4. Please refer to your booking confirmation message or e-mail.
 
Q5. Do you provide parking?
A5. We do not have dedicated parking available unless you have booked for our property in Hurstville. Street parking may be available, please be mindful of parking limits and costs.
 
Q6. Do you offer transport?
A6. No -  We do not offer transport. Please arrange your own transport services.
 
Q7. Do you allow pets at your property?
A7. No – We have a strict no pet policy.
 
Q8. Do you provide clean linen and bath towels?
A8. Yes! We provide these amenities upon arrival free of charge; you just need to bring yourself and your own essential items. For extra linen and towels there will be an additional charge, please contact us to arrange.
 
Q9. Do you do housekeeping?
A9. Yes -  We offer housekeeping but with a charge. The cost will be the same as the cleaning fee, please contact us to arrange.
 
Q10. I may have to change my booking dates. How do I do that?
A10. This depends on which platform you have booked with:
Airbnb - Please go on to your trips page and request for a date alteration, please note that this will be subject to availability. If you are unable to make a request for yourself, please contact us directly and we can check for you.
Bcom - Please contact customer service.
All other platforms and direct bookings - Please contact us directly.
 
Q11. I need to cancel my reservation. Will there be a cancellation fee?
A11. It depends.
If you need to cancel your reservation because we can’t host you, or circumstances relating to our fault, you are eligible for a full refund provided you confirm the booking cancellation. If you do not confirm your cancellation, you will be charged depending on how many days have passed.
If you need to cancel your reservation because of extenuating circumstances, we have a 3-day advanced notice policy for free cancellations. For cancellations within 3-days of check-in, you will be charged the daily rate for each day of delay. Proof of extenuating circumstances will be required.
For all other cancellations, please refer to the cancellation policy you have booked under.
Please note for all booking platforms other than Airbnb and Bcom, there will be a 10% surcharge for all refunds.
 
Q12. How do I cancel my reservation?
A12. This will depend on the platform you have booked with:
Airbnb – Go to your trips page and select cancellation options.
Bcom - Please contact customer service and notify us via the inbox.
All other platforms and direct bookings – Please contact us directly.
 
Q13. I need to extend my booking; how do I do that?
A13. Booking extensions are subject to availability and not guaranteed unless confirmed. For the best chances of extension, please make a request at least 24 hours before check-out. Please refer to the following:
Airbnb – Go to your trips page, request your date change and then notify us via the inbox. If you are unable to put in the request, please contact us via the inbox – Include details with your new dates needed.
Bcom - Please contact customer service on and notify us via the inbox - Include details with your new dates needed.
All other platforms and direct bookings – Please contact us directly and include details with your new dates needed.
 
Q14. I need to shorten my reservation; Will there be a fee? How do I do that?
A14. It depends. We have a 3-day advanced notice policy, if you let us know at least 3-days prior to your new check-out date, we can give you a refund of the remaining nights. If you want to shorten your reservation because of an issue you encounter at our property, please contact us and we may be able to waive the fee. Please refer to the following:
Airbnb – Go to your trips page, request your date change and then notify us via the inbox. If you are unable to put in the request, please contact us via the inbox – Include details with your new dates needed.
Bcom - Please contact customer service on and notify us via the inbox - Include details with your new dates needed.
All other platforms and direct bookings – Please contact us directly and include details with your new dates needed. There will be a 10% processing fee applicable for all refunds.
 
Q15. I have not received my check-in instructions yet. What should I do?
A15. This depends on which platform you have booked with:
Airbnb - Please ensure that it is at least 3-hours prior to our check-in time. If you still have not received it, please contact us via the inbox.
Bcom – Please ensure that you have filled out the check-in form at least 3-hours prior to our check-in time for bookings made more than 1 day in advance, or 30-minutes after booking confirmation for same day bookings. If you still have not received it, please contact us via the inbox.
For all other platforms and direct bookings - Please ensure that you have filled out the check-in form at least 3-hours prior to our check-in time for bookings made more than 1 day in advance, or 30-minutes after booking confirmation for same day bookings. Please ensure your payment is not declined and you do not have payments pending. If you still have not received it, please contact us directly.
 
Q16. I have not received any messages or emails. What should I do? (Excluding Airbnb)
A16. Please check your emails, if you have not received anything or are missing emails from us, please check your spam inbox. Please ensure that your contact details are correct, and if you still have not received anything, please contact us directly.
 
Q17. Access - How to access the property using the code provided?
A17. Please refer to the following:
Smart Lock - Enter the digits provided followed by the ‘#’ or ‘*’ sign. Please note that the numbers will still register even if there is no sound. If there are no numbers on the screen, please lightly tap the screen and the numbers should appear.
Key Lock Box – Input the correct digits and unlock the box to receive the key inside. Once you have access to the key, close the lock box and scramble the code. Please make sure to return the key at check-out.
 
Q18. I followed the check-in instructions, but I still cannot access the property. What should I do?
A18. Please refer to the following.
Smart Lock:
Verification failed – Please contact us directly.
Lock alarm going off – Please wait for at least 5-minutes after the alarm stops and try again.
Nothing happens when I enter the code – Please move the door in and out and try again, the door might have jammed. Refer to the “Q17. Access” section in the FAQ(s), please contact us directly if you still cannot access the property.
Key Lock Box:
Lock box not unlocking – Ensure you have input the right digits and you have tried to lightly pull open the lock. Please contact us directly if you still cannot access the lock.
Missing Key – The cleaner may be using the key to clean the property at the moment, please contact us directly.
 
Q19. I have arrived but my property is not cleaned yet, what do I do?
A19. Our check-in time is at 4PM. If you have arrived before this time, your property may not be ready yet. Please refer to the “Q2. Luggage Drop Off” section in the FAQ(s).
 
Q20. I am checking out soon, is there anything else I need to do?
A20. If you did not receive a physical key, there is nothing else you need to do, however we would appreciate it greatly if you could let us know when you have checked out as this will help with our cleaning schedule. If you received a physical key, please make sure to return the key to the original location and scramble the code before checking out.
 
Q21. Can I leave unwashed dishes in the sink?
A21. No – The cleaning fee is for the property to be cleaned prior to your stay. If you leave unwashed dishes, you will be charged an extra $50.
 
Q22. Who can I contact for assistance?
A22. Please contact us through the inbox of your booking platform or contact us directly. As we have multiple staff looking after the inbox, you may receive a response faster by leaving us a message through the booking platform’s inbox.
 
Thank you!

This is perfect for couples, solo adventurers, business workers or a small group of friends. 
This guesthouse is situated on a quiet street with unlimited free street parking and conveniently located walking distance to nearby amenities and eateries (Supermarket, Liquor Store, Butchery, Asian & European restaurants & cafes, VIP Lounge, Chemist/pharmacy). 
This home is centrally located between Parramatta and Sydney CBD which makes travelling and exploring the whole of Sydney and local hotspots easy! With many returning guests, we are sure you will love it here!
THE GUEST HOUSE:
This private boutique guest house is a 2-storey home with a stylish, modern design just 2-minutes’ walk from Berala railway station & bus stops. 
Here are some details on this beautiful guest house:
- 1 Private Bedroom - Sample photos - all rooms has the same amenities
- 2 Shared bathrooms
- Combined kitchen/dining room with a dining table and chairs
- Free Wi-Fi fast speed NBN
- Fans provided during summer
- The lounge kitchen laundry areas are cleaned twice a week professionally

THE BEDROOM:
First Floor:
ROOM: Has a double bed, bedside table, windows, closet and a study desk. First floor. Sleeps 2 people.

*Shared spaces include the kitchen/dining area, bathrooms/toilets, laundry room, the front yard/veranda and the outdoor area at the back.

THE KITCHEN / DINING AREA:
We understand that food is an essential part of every trip, so we have provided a fully equipped kitchen that is always ready if you wish to cook up a storm. There is a fridge, microwave, stove top, oven, kettle, toaster, pots, pans, crockery and a medium-sized dining table in the kitchen/dining area perfect for any eating needs. Most of our guests don't cook however because of our location - there are just so many restaurants for a decent price, not even a minute's walk from where we are! Therefore, we don't put on breakfast.

The dining area is the perfect area of the house to go to when you have tasty food to devour. Whether you decide to cook up a storm in our kitchen or order takeaway, there is no better place to eat than the dining room. The dining room has a medium table which can accommodate up to 4 people at a time.

THE BATHROOMS:
There are 2 modern communal bathrooms for you, our guests to use. One is located on the first floor next to the laundry room, and the other is on the second floor. Each bathroom comes fully equipped with a shower, essential amenities, basin, drawer, mirror-cabinet, ventilation and a toilet. The upstairs bathroom also contains a bathtub, if you prefer bathing instead!

THE LAUNDRY ROOM:
Accidentally spilt some coffee on your shirt? Or got clothes that need cleaning? Don’t worry! Our laundry room has a large basin, iron, ironing board, cleaning essentials, washing machine and a machine dryer for all your basic cleaning needs. There is also a clothesline in the back yard for you to dry your clothes.

THE FRONT YARD / VERANDA:
The front yard/veranda is the place to go when you need to have a cigarette or just to grab some fresh air. Decorated with trees and ground lamps, this brings home a relaxing atmosphere.

THE OUTDOOR HANGOUT AREA / BACKYARD:
This is the part of the guest house where guests may go outdoors to eat/drink, get some fresh air, have a cigarette or just to relax and have some banter. The outdoor area has a concrete floor, 3 wooden chairs, a small wooden table which can accommodate up to 3 people at a time and a clothesline for all your drying needs.

GREAT FOR SOLO ADVENTURERS:
Whether you are a backpacker travelling or just looking for a place to stay, our accommodation welcomes you!
-Affordable pricing
-Opportunity to meet new people
-Centrally located to many hotspots with convenient transportation makes exploring easy

GREAT FOR COUPLES:
Perfect for couples whether travelling or just looking for a place to stay after a night out.
-Modern design rooms with double beds *ROOM3 is bunkbed*

GREAT FOR SMALL GROUPS OF FRIENDS:
The guest house is a great place to host your group trip to Sydney if you book more than 1 room. 
-Close to Berala CBD, where you can go shopping locally.
-Please contact me if you would like to inquire/book more than 1 room. Details of other rooms will be provided through links with photos. 

GREAT FOR STUDENTS:
This guest house is excellent for students looking to study University, College or TAFE.
-Convenient public transportation – 2mins walking distance to train station and bus stops 

GREAT FOR WORKERS:
Looking for a place to stay while you’re working? Look no further, we got you! We have hosted many guests that need to work close by, and many of them found this guest house the perfect location, as it is close to the industrial areas.
-Close to the industrial areas.
-Perfect for a small group of workers to stay if you book more than 1 room.

publicDescription.neighborhood:
Berala is a western suburb of Sydney, in the state of New South Wales, Australia, located 20 kilometres west of the central business district, in the local government area of Cumberland Council.
Berala is derived from Bareela, an Aboriginal word for a musk duck. The area was originally swampy and attracted wild birds. When the railway line was being extended from Lidcombe to Regents Park, the names Torrington, Sidmouth and Bareela were considered. The station opened in 1912, the public school in 1924 and the post office in 1927.

[Entire Unit Bookings] – Entire unit with all private facilities. No other guests will be present inside the unit.

Kitchen [Private Room & Entire Unit] – Please wash your own dishes and keep the area clean; the cleaning fee is for cleaning your property after checkout, not including your dishes. An additional cleaning fee will apply for leaving unwashed dishes.
Bathroom [Private Room & Entire Unit] – Please clean up after yourself and leave the area dry and clean for the next guests.
Rubbish [Private Room & Entire Unit] – Please dispose of rubbish in the correct bin(s) outside the house.
E-Bikes & Related Charging Devices [Private Room & Entire Unit] – E-Bikes are strictly prohibited anywhere on the premises at all times (including outdoor areas). This includes any related charging equipment, such as battery packs or similar devices. Communal Fridge [Private Room] – Do not take food that is not yours, label your own food and remove after checkout.
Quiet Hours [Private Room] – Quiet hours from 10:00 PM to 8:00 AM, please be mindful and considerate of other guests and your neighbours. No loud machinery, music or noises is permitted during this time.
Quiet Hours [Entire Unit] – Quiet neighbourhood hours from 10:00 PM to 8:00 AM, please be mindful and considerate of your neighbours. No loud machinery, music or noises is permitted during this time.
No Smoking, Drugs, or Excessive Alcohol [Private Room & Entire Unit] – On the premises at any given time. Failure to adhere to this rule will incur an additional cleaning fine of $250 AUD plus a $2500 AUD fine from the NSW Fire Department.
1. Smoking is allowed outside the building, away from the entrance and windows, with proper disposal.
Language [Private Room] – Please do not use offensive words or language on the property.
No Pets [Private Room & Entire Unit] – As much as we love pets, our property has a strict no-pet policy.
No Additional Guests [Private Room & Entire Unit] – No additional guests are permitted without prior approval from the property. Guests are responsible for the behaviour of their guests and any approved visitors.
No Parties [Private Room & Entire Unit] – Strictly no parties of any kind. A violation will result in the police being called to the premises, and the reservation will be cancelled immediately with no refunds.
On-time Check-out [Private Room & Entire Unit] – Please ensure you check out on time. If your luggage is still inside the property by check-out time, your luggage will be removed from the premises and placed outside the property. We will try to contact you before doing so.
Complaint Resolution [Private Room & Entire Unit] – If you encounter issues, you agree to notify the property as soon as discovered. Issues encountered but not reported will not be grounds for compensation. Should the issue qualify for compensation, this will start from the time it was first reported.

—– ADDITIONAL PROPERTY INFORMATION —–

Our apartments are equipped with energy-saving systems that use PIR (passive infrared) sensors to automatically turn off the AC when no guests are in the room.

In some units, there may also be a limit on how low the temperature can be set.

To get you started, we provide a complimentary welcome kit that includes:
Toilet paper
Trash bags
Dish soap
Hand soap
Shampoo
Coffee, sugar, sweetener
Bottled water

These items are not restocked during your stay. If you need more, please purchase them locally.
Please note that we do not provide dishwasher detergent, even if the apartment includes a dishwasher.

Some buildings require a valid ID upon check-in due to local regulations. This is mandatory.
If this is a concern, please contact us before confirming your reservation, as we cannot issue cancellations or refunds for this reason.

For stays of 28 nights or more, electricity is billed separately at a rate of 3 MXN per kWh.

unconfirmedFirstMessage.message:
------This is an automated message, please do not reply------

Dear {{guest_first}}, sorry for the delay, I will be with you as soon as possible! If you don't require a response, please kindly ignore this message.

Please note that our office hours are between 9AM-6PM, Monday – Friday. Delays in response outside of this timeframe and on the weekends may be expected. 

If you have not received a response yet, please check out our frequently asked questions (FAQ) below:

**FAQ - Frequently Asked Questions**

Q1. Can I early check-in or late check-out?
A1. Early check-in requests are subject to the previous day's availability, please contact us on the day of check-in to check availability. Alternatively, you may book 1 day ahead of your check-in date to guarantee an early check-in. Late check-out requests are only available until 11AM if approved, please contact us directly to arrange this.
 
Q2. Luggage Drop Off - Can I drop off my luggage before check-in or store my luggage to collect later after check-out?
A2. This depends on whether you have booked for a private room, or for the whole house. If you have booked for a private room, we have chain-locks available in the common area with keys attached, please feel free to use this if you require luggage storage. If you have booked for a full house, we do not currently have any storage facilities for luggage storage.
 
Q3. Will there be anyone to receive me once I arrive?
A3. No - This is a self-check-in property, we will send you check-in instructions on how to access the property. We only provide online reception.
 
Q4. Where is your property address located?
A4. Please refer to your booking confirmation message or e-mail.
 
Q5. Do you provide parking?
A5. We do not have dedicated parking available unless you have booked for our property in Hurstville. Street parking may be available, please be mindful of parking limits and costs.
 
Q6. Do you offer transport?
A6. No -  We do not offer transport. Please arrange your own transport services.
 
Q7. Do you allow pets at your property?
A7. No – We have a strict no pet policy.
 
Q8. Do you provide clean linen and bath towels?
A8. Yes! We provide these amenities upon arrival free of charge; you just need to bring yourself and your own essential items. For extra linen and towels there will be an additional charge, please contact us to arrange.
 
Q9. Do you do housekeeping?
A9. Yes -  We offer housekeeping but with a charge. The cost will be the same as the cleaning fee, please contact us to arrange.
 
Q10. I may have to change my booking dates. How do I do that?
A10. This depends on which platform you have booked with:
Airbnb - Please go on to your trips page and request for a date alteration, please note that this will be subject to availability. If you are unable to make a request for yourself, please contact us directly and we can check for you.
Bcom - Please contact customer service.
All other platforms and direct bookings - Please contact us directly.
 
Q11. I need to cancel my reservation. Will there be a cancellation fee?
A11. It depends.
If you need to cancel your reservation because we can’t host you, or circumstances relating to our fault, you are eligible for a full refund provided you confirm the booking cancellation. If you do not confirm your cancellation, you will be charged depending on how many days have passed.
If you need to cancel your reservation because of extenuating circumstances, we have a 3-day advanced notice policy for free cancellations. For cancellations within 3-days of check-in, you will be charged the daily rate for each day of delay. Proof of extenuating circumstances will be required.
For all other cancellations, please refer to the cancellation policy you have booked under.
Please note for all booking platforms other than Airbnb and Bcom, there will be a 10% surcharge for all refunds.
 
Q12. How do I cancel my reservation?
A12. This will depend on the platform you have booked with:
Airbnb – Go to your trips page and select cancellation options.
Bcom - Please contact customer service and notify us via the inbox.
All other platforms and direct bookings – Please contact us directly.
 
Q13. I need to extend my booking; how do I do that?
A13. Booking extensions are subject to availability and not guaranteed unless confirmed. For the best chances of extension, please make a request at least 24 hours before check-out. Please refer to the following:
Airbnb – Go to your trips page, request your date change and then notify us via the inbox. If you are unable to put in the request, please contact us via the inbox – Include details with your new dates needed.
Bcom - Please contact customer service on and notify us via the inbox - Include details with your new dates needed.
All other platforms and direct bookings – Please contact us directly and include details with your new dates needed.
 
Q14. I need to shorten my reservation; Will there be a fee? How do I do that?
A14. It depends. We have a 3-day advanced notice policy, if you let us know at least 3-days prior to your new check-out date, we can give you a refund of the remaining nights. If you want to shorten your reservation because of an issue you encounter at our property, please contact us and we may be able to waive the fee. Please refer to the following:
Airbnb – Go to your trips page, request your date change and then notify us via the inbox. If you are unable to put in the request, please contact us via the inbox – Include details with your new dates needed.
Bcom - Please contact customer service on and notify us via the inbox - Include details with your new dates needed.
All other platforms and direct bookings – Please contact us directly and include details with your new dates needed. There will be a 10% processing fee applicable for all refunds.
 
Q15. I have not received my check-in instructions yet. What should I do?
A15. This depends on which platform you have booked with:
Airbnb - Please ensure that it is at least 3-hours prior to our check-in time. If you still have not received it, please contact us via the inbox.
Bcom – Please ensure that you have filled out the check-in form at least 3-hours prior to our check-in time for bookings made more than 1 day in advance, or 30-minutes after booking confirmation for same day bookings. If you still have not received it, please contact us via the inbox.
For all other platforms and direct bookings - Please ensure that you have filled out the check-in form at least 3-hours prior to our check-in time for bookings made more than 1 day in advance, or 30-minutes after booking confirmation for same day bookings. Please ensure your payment is not declined and you do not have payments pending. If you still have not received it, please contact us directly.
 
Q16. I have not received any messages or emails. What should I do? (Excluding Airbnb)
A16. Please check your emails, if you have not received anything or are missing emails from us, please check your spam inbox. Please ensure that your contact details are correct, and if you still have not received anything, please contact us directly.
 
Q17. Access - How to access the property using the code provided?
A17. Please refer to the following:
Smart Lock - Enter the digits provided followed by the ‘#’ or ‘*’ sign. Please note that the numbers will still register even if there is no sound. If there are no numbers on the screen, please lightly tap the screen and the numbers should appear.
Key Lock Box – Input the correct digits and unlock the box to receive the key inside. Once you have access to the key, close the lock box and scramble the code. Please make sure to return the key at check-out.
 
Q18. I followed the check-in instructions, but I still cannot access the property. What should I do?
A18. Please refer to the following.
Smart Lock:
Verification failed – Please contact us directly.
Lock alarm going off – Please wait for at least 5-minutes after the alarm stops and try again.
Nothing happens when I enter the code – Please move the door in and out and try again, the door might have jammed. Refer to the “Q17. Access” section in the FAQ(s), please contact us directly if you still cannot access the property.
Key Lock Box:
Lock box not unlocking – Ensure you have input the right digits and you have tried to lightly pull open the lock. Please contact us directly if you still cannot access the lock.
Missing Key – The cleaner may be using the key to clean the property at the moment, please contact us directly.
 
Q19. I have arrived but my property is not cleaned yet, what do I do?
A19. Our check-in time is at 4PM. If you have arrived before this time, your property may not be ready yet. Please refer to the “Q2. Luggage Drop Off” section in the FAQ(s).
 
Q20. I am checking out soon, is there anything else I need to do?
A20. If you did not receive a physical key, there is nothing else you need to do, however we would appreciate it greatly if you could let us know when you have checked out as this will help with our cleaning schedule. If you received a physical key, please make sure to return the key to the original location and scramble the code before checking out.
 
Q21. Can I leave unwashed dishes in the sink?
A21. No – The cleaning fee is for the property to be cleaned prior to your stay. If you leave unwashed dishes, you will be charged an extra $50.
 
Q22. Who can I contact for assistance?
A22. Please contact us through the inbox of your booking platform or contact us directly. As we have multiple staff looking after the inbox, you may receive a response faster by leaving us a message through the booking platform’s inbox.
 
Thank you!

Looking for an affordable place to stay while exploring, studying or working in Sydney? Got an event nearby and need somewhere comfortable to stay the night? If so, then our Artistic Guesthouse is perfect for you!

Located in Chippendale is our 2-storey modern design Artistic Terrace House. It is situated on a busy street in the heart of the Sydney CBD, just 3-minute walk from Central station!

Our place is great for couples, solo adventurers, students and business travelers alike.

publicDescription.space:
These are sample room photos - all rooms have similar amenities

This private room is renovated with a professional designer, it boasts an artistic, stylish design which brings a very relaxing atmosphere and we are sure you will love it here.

If you are looking for something nice, convenient and close to everything, then this is the place for you!

THE GUEST HOUSE:
This private artistic guest house is a 2-storey modern terrace home with a stylish design just 3-minutes’ walk from Central train station. It is perfect for couples, solo adventurers, business travellers or a small group of friends. Here are some details on this beautiful guest house:
- Situated on a busy street within walking distance to the nearest train station and local hotspots
- 1 Private Bedroom with En Suite Bathroom
- Decorated in a Modern Hospitality Style
- Free Wi-Fi throughout the house
- Communal areas are cleaned 2x a week

THE BEDROOM:
Has a double bed, window, study desk and a private bathroom. Sleeps 2 people.

Common spaces include the kitchen, bathroom in common area, hallway and laundry area. These areas need to be shared with other guests

THE KITCHEN AREA:
We understand that food is an integral part of every trip, so we have provided a simple kitchen that is always ready if you wish to cook basic things. There are a fridge, microwave, small stove top, kettle, toaster, pots, pans and crockery. 

THE LAUNDRY AREA:
Have you spilt some coffee on your shirt? Or got clothes that need cleaning? Don’t worry! Our laundry area has a large basin, iron, cleaning essentials, 1 washing machines and a machine dryer (on the 1st floor) for all your basic cleaning needs.

THE BATHROOM:
The room comes with your very own private en suite bathroom. The bathroom comes fully equipped with a shower, essential amenities, basin, drawer, mirror-cabinet, ventilation and a toilet. There is also a shared bathroom next to the kitchen. 

THE HALLWAYS:
Have you arrived earlier than expected to an Airbnb and had to wait around with your luggage? You wanted to make the most of your day and explore the city, but you had all that extra troublesome luggage? Or even checking out earlier in the day but not due to fly until late? Don’t worry! With our property, we offer you storage underneath the stairs and provide chain locks in case you want to secure your belongings. With this, you are free to leave your luggage at our property while you go explore the best of what Sydney has to offer. *Although we provide chain locks, we are not liable for any damage/loss of property. *

GREAT FOR SOLO ADVENTURERS:
Whether you are a backpacker travelling or just looking for a place to stay, our accommodation welcomes you!
- Extremely competitive pricing
- Opportunity to meet new people

GREAT FOR COUPLES:
Perfect for couples whether travelling or just looking for a place to stay after a night out.
- Modern design rooms with double beds
- Intimate setting

GREAT FOR STUDENTS:
This guest house is excellent for students looking to study University, College or TAFE.
- Walking distance to the train station and bus stops makes public transportation extremely convenient.
- Heart of Sydney CBD

GREAT FOR WORKERS:
Looking for a place to stay while you’re working? Look no further, we got you! We have hosted many guests that need to work close by, and many of them found this guest house the perfect location.
- Walking distance to the train station and bus stops makes public transportation extremely convenient.
- Heart of Sydney CBD.
- Perfect for a small group of workers to stay.
- Affordable for solo workers.

GREAT FOR SMALL GROUPS OF FRIENDS:
The guest house is a great place to host your group trip to Sydney. 
- Close to Sydney CBD, where you can go shopping or partying locally.

Entrance is from the front door on the ground floor, and there is paid parking on the streets. 

Parking in Sydney CBD are high in demand and not always easy to find. Hence, we recommend getting to and around the CBD through our convenient access to public transport. There are buses that run in and around the city area, as well as trains, light rail and ferries with stops and options for getting to the main attractions.

publicDescription.neighborhood:
Chippendale is an evolving area known for its stylish cultural and cafe scene. Terraced houses on Crown and Cleveland streets showcase hip coffee joints, fashion boutiques & global eateries. Trendy pubs, wine bars & galleries dot this community hub with a contemporary design. Held once a month, the Surry Hills Markets lure shoppers for snacks and vintage goods. It is an excellent place to be! 
As well as being the name of the most impressive city in the world, Sydney is the name of the suburb that covers the CBD, Opera House, The Rocks, Circular Quay and Darling Harbour.
So, you know you're going to get views, history and plenty of places to booze with the suits. But what makes Sydney great are its fabulous little mini-burbs.

•	2 to 6 mins walk to several bus stops, which takes you to the most of Sydney’s tourist attractions

•	20 mins walk to Sydney Tower Eye, St Mary’s Cathedral, Martin Place 
•	20 mins walk to Townhall, QVB & Pitt St Mall
•	35 mins walk to iconic Sydney Opera House & the Harbour Bridge, and Circular Quay Wharf
•	35 mins by bus to the world-famous Bondi Beach

unconfirmedFirstMessage.message:
------This is an automated message, please do not reply------

Dear {{guest_first}}, sorry for the delay, I will be with you as soon as possible! If you don't require a response, please kindly ignore this message.

Please note that our office hours are between 9AM-6PM, Monday – Friday. Delays in response outside of this timeframe and on the weekends may be expected. 

If you have not received a response yet, please check out our frequently asked questions (FAQ) below:

**FAQ - Frequently Asked Questions**

Q1. Can I early check-in or late check-out?
A1. Early check-in requests are subject to the previous day's availability, please contact us on the day of check-in to check availability. Alternatively, you may book 1 day ahead of your check-in date to guarantee an early check-in. Late check-out requests are only available until 11AM if approved, please contact us directly to arrange this.
 
Q2. Luggage Drop Off - Can I drop off my luggage before check-in or store my luggage to collect later after check-out?
A2. This depends on whether you have booked for a private room, or for the whole house. If you have booked for a private room, we have chain-locks available in the common area with keys attached, please feel free to use this if you require luggage storage. If you have booked for a full house, we do not currently have any storage facilities for luggage storage.
 
Q3. Will there be anyone to receive me once I arrive?
A3. No - This is a self-check-in property, we will send you check-in instructions on how to access the property. We only provide online reception.
 
Q4. Where is your property address located?
A4. Please refer to your booking confirmation message or e-mail.
 
Q5. Do you provide parking?
A5. We do not have dedicated parking available unless you have booked for our property in Hurstville. Street parking may be available, please be mindful of parking limits and costs.
 
Q6. Do you offer transport?
A6. No -  We do not offer transport. Please arrange your own transport services.
 
Q7. Do you allow pets at your property?
A7. No – We have a strict no pet policy.
 
Q8. Do you provide clean linen and bath towels?
A8. Yes! We provide these amenities upon arrival free of charge; you just need to bring yourself and your own essential items. For extra linen and towels there will be an additional charge, please contact us to arrange.
 
Q9. Do you do housekeeping?
A9. Yes -  We offer housekeeping but with a charge. The cost will be the same as the cleaning fee, please contact us to arrange.
 
Q10. I may have to change my booking dates. How do I do that?
A10. This depends on which platform you have booked with:
Airbnb - Please go on to your trips page and request for a date alteration, please note that this will be subject to availability. If you are unable to make a request for yourself, please contact us directly and we can check for you.
Bcom - Please contact customer service.
All other platforms and direct bookings - Please contact us directly.
 
Q11. I need to cancel my reservation. Will there be a cancellation fee?
A11. It depends.
If you need to cancel your reservation because we can’t host you, or circumstances relating to our fault, you are eligible for a full refund provided you confirm the booking cancellation. If you do not confirm your cancellation, you will be charged depending on how many days have passed.
If you need to cancel your reservation because of extenuating circumstances, we have a 3-day advanced notice policy for free cancellations. For cancellations within 3-days of check-in, you will be charged the daily rate for each day of delay. Proof of extenuating circumstances will be required.
For all other cancellations, please refer to the cancellation policy you have booked under.
Please note for all booking platforms other than Airbnb and Bcom, there will be a 10% surcharge for all refunds.
 
Q12. How do I cancel my reservation?
A12. This will depend on the platform you have booked with:
Airbnb – Go to your trips page and select cancellation options.
Bcom - Please contact customer service and notify us via the inbox.
All other platforms and direct bookings – Please contact us directly.
 
Q13. I need to extend my booking; how do I do that?
A13. Booking extensions are subject to availability and not guaranteed unless confirmed. For the best chances of extension, please make a request at least 24 hours before check-out. Please refer to the following:
Airbnb – Go to your trips page, request your date change and then notify us via the inbox. If you are unable to put in the request, please contact us via the inbox – Include details with your new dates needed.
Bcom - Please contact customer service on and notify us via the inbox - Include details with your new dates needed.
All other platforms and direct bookings – Please contact us directly and include details with your new dates needed.
 
Q14. I need to shorten my reservation; Will there be a fee? How do I do that?
A14. It depends. We have a 3-day advanced notice policy, if you let us know at least 3-days prior to your new check-out date, we can give you a refund of the remaining nights. If you want to shorten your reservation because of an issue you encounter at our property, please contact us and we may be able to waive the fee. Please refer to the following:
Airbnb – Go to your trips page, request your date change and then notify us via the inbox. If you are unable to put in the request, please contact us via the inbox – Include details with your new dates needed.
Bcom - Please contact customer service on and notify us via the inbox - Include details with your new dates needed.
All other platforms and direct bookings – Please contact us directly and include details with your new dates needed. There will be a 10% processing fee applicable for all refunds.
 
Q15. I have not received my check-in instructions yet. What should I do?
A15. This depends on which platform you have booked with:
Airbnb - Please ensure that it is at least 3-hours prior to our check-in time. If you still have not received it, please contact us via the inbox.
Bcom – Please ensure that you have filled out the check-in form at least 3-hours prior to our check-in time for bookings made more than 1 day in advance, or 30-minutes after booking confirmation for same day bookings. If you still have not received it, please contact us via the inbox.
For all other platforms and direct bookings - Please ensure that you have filled out the check-in form at least 3-hours prior to our check-in time for bookings made more than 1 day in advance, or 30-minutes after booking confirmation for same day bookings. Please ensure your payment is not declined and you do not have payments pending. If you still have not received it, please contact us directly.
 
Q16. I have not received any messages or emails. What should I do? (Excluding Airbnb)
A16. Please check your emails, if you have not received anything or are missing emails from us, please check your spam inbox. Please ensure that your contact details are correct, and if you still have not received anything, please contact us directly.
 
Q17. Access - How to access the property using the code provided?
A17. Please refer to the following:
Smart Lock - Enter the digits provided followed by the ‘#’ or ‘*’ sign. Please note that the numbers will still register even if there is no sound. If there are no numbers on the screen, please lightly tap the screen and the numbers should appear.
Key Lock Box – Input the correct digits and unlock the box to receive the key inside. Once you have access to the key, close the lock box and scramble the code. Please make sure to return the key at check-out.
 
Q18. I followed the check-in instructions, but I still cannot access the property. What should I do?
A18. Please refer to the following.
Smart Lock:
Verification failed – Please contact us directly.
Lock alarm going off – Please wait for at least 5-minutes after the alarm stops and try again.
Nothing happens when I enter the code – Please move the door in and out and try again, the door might have jammed. Refer to the “Q17. Access” section in the FAQ(s), please contact us directly if you still cannot access the property.
Key Lock Box:
Lock box not unlocking – Ensure you have input the right digits and you have tried to lightly pull open the lock. Please contact us directly if you still cannot access the lock.
Missing Key – The cleaner may be using the key to clean the property at the moment, please contact us directly.
 
Q19. I have arrived but my property is not cleaned yet, what do I do?
A19. Our check-in time is at 4PM. If you have arrived before this time, your property may not be ready yet. Please refer to the “Q2. Luggage Drop Off” section in the FAQ(s).
 
Q20. I am checking out soon, is there anything else I need to do?
A20. If you did not receive a physical key, there is nothing else you need to do, however we would appreciate it greatly if you could let us know when you have checked out as this will help with our cleaning schedule. If you received a physical key, please make sure to return the key to the original location and scramble the code before checking out.
 
Q21. Can I leave unwashed dishes in the sink?
A21. No – The cleaning fee is for the property to be cleaned prior to your stay. If you leave unwashed dishes, you will be charged an extra $50.
 
Q22. Who can I contact for assistance?
A22. Please contact us through the inbox of your booking platform or contact us directly. As we have multiple staff looking after the inbox, you may receive a response faster by leaving us a message through the booking platform’s inbox.
 
Thank you!

publicDescription.summary:
Looking for an affordable place to stay while exploring, studying or working in Sydney? Got an event nearby and need somewhere comfortable to stay the night? If so, then our Artistic Guesthouse is perfect for you!

Located in Chippendale is our 2-storey modern design Artistic Terrace House. It is situated on a busy street in the heart of the Sydney CBD, just 3-minute walk from Central station!

Our place is great for couples, solo adventurers, students and business travelers alike.
publicDescription.space:
These are sample room photos - all rooms have similar amenities

This private room is renovated with a professional designer, it boasts an artistic, stylish design which brings a very relaxing atmosphere and we are sure you will love it here.

If you are looking for something nice, convenient and close to everything, then this is the place for you!

THE GUEST HOUSE:
This private artistic guest house is a 2-storey modern terrace home with a stylish design just 3-minutes’ walk from Central train station. It is perfect for couples, solo adventurers, business travellers or a small group of friends. Here are some details on this beautiful guest house:
- Situated on a busy street within walking distance to the nearest train station and local hotspots
- 1 Private Bedroom with En Suite Bathroom
- Decorated in a Modern Hospitality Style
- Free Wi-Fi throughout the house
- Communal areas are cleaned 2x a week

THE BEDROOM:
Has a double bed, window, study desk and a private bathroom. Sleeps 2 people.

Common spaces include the kitchen, bathroom in common area, hallway and laundry area. These areas need to be shared with other guests

THE KITCHEN AREA:
We understand that food is an integral part of every trip, so we have provided a simple kitchen that is always ready if you wish to cook basic things. There are a fridge, microwave, small stove top, kettle, toaster, pots, pans and crockery. 

THE LAUNDRY AREA:
Have you spilt some coffee on your shirt? Or got clothes that need cleaning? Don’t worry! Our laundry area has a large basin, iron, cleaning essentials, 1 washing machines and a machine dryer (on the 1st floor) for all your basic cleaning needs.

THE BATHROOM:
The room comes with your very own private en suite bathroom. The bathroom comes fully equipped with a shower, essential amenities, basin, drawer, mirror-cabinet, ventilation and a toilet. There is also a shared bathroom next to the kitchen. 

THE HALLWAYS:
Have you arrived earlier than expected to an Airbnb and had to wait around with your luggage? You wanted to make the most of your day and explore the city, but you had all that extra troublesome luggage? Or even checking out earlier in the day but not due to fly until late? Don’t worry! With our property, we offer you storage underneath the stairs and provide chain locks in case you want to secure your belongings. With this, you are free to leave your luggage at our property while you go explore the best of what Sydney has to offer. *Although we provide chain locks, we are not liable for any damage/loss of property. *

GREAT FOR SOLO ADVENTURERS:
Whether you are a backpacker travelling or just looking for a place to stay, our accommodation welcomes you!
- Extremely competitive pricing
- Opportunity to meet new people

GREAT FOR COUPLES:
Perfect for couples whether travelling or just looking for a place to stay after a night out.
- Modern design rooms with double beds
- Intimate setting

GREAT FOR STUDENTS:
This guest house is excellent for students looking to study University, College or TAFE.
- Walking distance to the train station and bus stops makes public transportation extremely convenient.
- Heart of Sydney CBD

GREAT FOR WORKERS:
Looking for a place to stay while you’re working? Look no further, we got you! We have hosted many guests that need to work close by, and many of them found this guest house the perfect location.
- Walking distance to the train station and bus stops makes public transportation extremely convenient.
- Heart of Sydney CBD.
- Perfect for a small group of workers to stay.
- Affordable for solo workers.

GREAT FOR SMALL GROUPS OF FRIENDS:
The guest house is a great place to host your group trip to Sydney. 
- Close to Sydney CBD, where you can go shopping or partying locally.

Entrance is from the front door on the ground floor, and there is paid parking on the streets. 

Parking in Sydney CBD are high in demand and not always easy to find. Hence, we recommend getting to and around the CBD through our convenient access to public transport. There are buses that run in and around the city area, as well as trains, light rail and ferries with stops and options for getting to the main attractions.

publicDescription.neighborhood:
Chippendale is an evolving area known for its stylish cultural and cafe scene. Terraced houses on Crown and Cleveland streets showcase hip coffee joints, fashion boutiques & global eateries. Trendy pubs, wine bars & galleries dot this community hub with a contemporary design. Held once a month, the Surry Hills Markets lure shoppers for snacks and vintage goods. It is an excellent place to be! 
As well as being the name of the most impressive city in the world, Sydney is the name of the suburb that covers the CBD, Opera House, The Rocks, Circular Quay and Darling Harbour.
So, you know you're going to get views, history and plenty of places to booze with the suits. But what makes Sydney great are its fabulous little mini-burbs.
publicDescription.transit:
Just 1-minute (30 meters) walk to Sydney Central Station, the largest station on the Sydney Trains and NSW Train Link networks
•	2 mins walk to Crown St – the heart of Surry Hills, packed with top restaurants, cafés, bars, boutiques, and specially designed stores
•	2 to 6 mins walk to several bus stops, which takes you to the most of Sydney’s tourist attractions
•	5 mins walk to Oxford St – Sydney’s most colourful street
•	10 mins walk to Hyde Park – Australia's oldest public parkland
•	12 mins walk to Chinatown – one of Sydney’s most beloved tourist attraction, Sydney Paddy’s Market is just next to Chinatown
•	15 mins walk to Powerhouse Museum – state-of-the-art exhibitions on futurology, transport and ecology
•	16 mins walk to Australian Museum - Australia's oldest museum which has expansive zoological and anthropological collections.
•	18 mins bus to The Domain
•	20 mins walk to Darling Harbour – Sydney’s entertainment hub
•	20 mins walk to Sydney Tower Eye, St Mary’s Cathedral, Martin Place 
•	20 mins walk to Townhall, QVB & Pitt St Mall
•	35 mins walk to iconic Sydney Opera House & the Harbour Bridge, and Circular Quay Wharf
•	35 mins by bus to the world-famous Bondi Beach

Dentistry Library University of Sydney

unconfirmedFirstMessage.message:
------This is an automated message, please do not reply------

Dear {{guest_first}}, sorry for the delay, I will be with you as soon as possible! If you don't require a response, please kindly ignore this message.

Please note that our office hours are between 9AM-6PM, Monday – Friday. Delays in response outside of this timeframe and on the weekends may be expected. 

If you have not received a response yet, please check out our frequently asked questions (FAQ) below:

**FAQ - Frequently Asked Questions**

Q1. Can I early check-in or late check-out?
A1. Early check-in requests are subject to the previous day's availability, please contact us on the day of check-in to check availability. Alternatively, you may book 1 day ahead of your check-in date to guarantee an early check-in. Late check-out requests are only available until 11AM if approved, please contact us directly to arrange this.
 
Q2. Luggage Drop Off - Can I drop off my luggage before check-in or store my luggage to collect later after check-out?
A2. This depends on whether you have booked for a private room, or for the whole house. If you have booked for a private room, we have chain-locks available in the common area with keys attached, please feel free to use this if you require luggage storage. If you have booked for a full house, we do not currently have any storage facilities for luggage storage.
 
Q3. Will there be anyone to receive me once I arrive?
A3. No - This is a self-check-in property, we will send you check-in instructions on how to access the property. We only provide online reception.
 
Q4. Where is your property address located?
A4. Please refer to your booking confirmation message or e-mail.
 
Q5. Do you provide parking?
A5. We do not have dedicated parking available unless you have booked for our property in Hurstville. Street parking may be available, please be mindful of parking limits and costs.
 
Q6. Do you offer transport?
A6. No -  We do not offer transport. Please arrange your own transport services.
 
Q7. Do you allow pets at your property?
A7. No – We have a strict no pet policy.
 
Q8. Do you provide clean linen and bath towels?
A8. Yes! We provide these amenities upon arrival free of charge; you just need to bring yourself and your own essential items. For extra linen and towels there will be an additional charge, please contact us to arrange.
 
Q9. Do you do housekeeping?
A9. Yes -  We offer housekeeping but with a charge. The cost will be the same as the cleaning fee, please contact us to arrange.
 
Q10. I may have to change my booking dates. How do I do that?
A10. This depends on which platform you have booked with:
Airbnb - Please go on to your trips page and request for a date alteration, please note that this will be subject to availability. If you are unable to make a request for yourself, please contact us directly and we can check for you.
Bcom - Please contact customer service.
All other platforms and direct bookings - Please contact us directly.
 
Q11. I need to cancel my reservation. Will there be a cancellation fee?
A11. It depends.
If you need to cancel your reservation because we can’t host you, or circumstances relating to our fault, you are eligible for a full refund provided you confirm the booking cancellation. If you do not confirm your cancellation, you will be charged depending on how many days have passed.
If you need to cancel your reservation because of extenuating circumstances, we have a 3-day advanced notice policy for free cancellations. For cancellations within 3-days of check-in, you will be charged the daily rate for each day of delay. Proof of extenuating circumstances will be required.
For all other cancellations, please refer to the cancellation policy you have booked under.
Please note for all booking platforms other than Airbnb and Bcom, there will be a 10% surcharge for all refunds.
 
Q12. How do I cancel my reservation?
A12. This will depend on the platform you have booked with:
Airbnb – Go to your trips page and select cancellation options.
Bcom - Please contact customer service and notify us via the inbox.
All other platforms and direct bookings – Please contact us directly.
 
Q13. I need to extend my booking; how do I do that?
A13. Booking extensions are subject to availability and not guaranteed unless confirmed. For the best chances of extension, please make a request at least 24 hours before check-out. Please refer to the following:
Airbnb – Go to your trips page, request your date change and then notify us via the inbox. If you are unable to put in the request, please contact us via the inbox – Include details with your new dates needed.
Bcom - Please contact customer service on and notify us via the inbox - Include details with your new dates needed.
All other platforms and direct bookings – Please contact us directly and include details with your new dates needed.
 
Q14. I need to shorten my reservation; Will there be a fee? How do I do that?
A14. It depends. We have a 3-day advanced notice policy, if you let us know at least 3-days prior to your new check-out date, we can give you a refund of the remaining nights. If you want to shorten your reservation because of an issue you encounter at our property, please contact us and we may be able to waive the fee. Please refer to the following:
Airbnb – Go to your trips page, request your date change and then notify us via the inbox. If you are unable to put in the request, please contact us via the inbox – Include details with your new dates needed.
Bcom - Please contact customer service on and notify us via the inbox - Include details with your new dates needed.
All other platforms and direct bookings – Please contact us directly and include details with your new dates needed. There will be a 10% processing fee applicable for all refunds.
 
Q15. I have not received my check-in instructions yet. What should I do?
A15. This depends on which platform you have booked with:
Airbnb - Please ensure that it is at least 3-hours prior to our check-in time. If you still have not received it, please contact us via the inbox.
Bcom – Please ensure that you have filled out the check-in form at least 3-hours prior to our check-in time for bookings made more than 1 day in advance, or 30-minutes after booking confirmation for same day bookings. If you still have not received it, please contact us via the inbox.
For all other platforms and direct bookings - Please ensure that you have filled out the check-in form at least 3-hours prior to our check-in time for bookings made more than 1 day in advance, or 30-minutes after booking confirmation for same day bookings. Please ensure your payment is not declined and you do not have payments pending. If you still have not received it, please contact us directly.
 
Q16. I have not received any messages or emails. What should I do? (Excluding Airbnb)
A16. Please check your emails, if you have not received anything or are missing emails from us, please check your spam inbox. Please ensure that your contact details are correct, and if you still have not received anything, please contact us directly.
 
Q17. Access - How to access the property using the code provided?
A17. Please refer to the following:
Smart Lock - Enter the digits provided followed by the ‘#’ or ‘*’ sign. Please note that the numbers will still register even if there is no sound. If there are no numbers on the screen, please lightly tap the screen and the numbers should appear.
Key Lock Box – Input the correct digits and unlock the box to receive the key inside. Once you have access to the key, close the lock box and scramble the code. Please make sure to return the key at check-out.
 
Q18. I followed the check-in instructions, but I still cannot access the property. What should I do?
A18. Please refer to the following.
Smart Lock:
Verification failed – Please contact us directly.
Lock alarm going off – Please wait for at least 5-minutes after the alarm stops and try again.
Nothing happens when I enter the code – Please move the door in and out and try again, the door might have jammed. Refer to the “Q17. Access” section in the FAQ(s), please contact us directly if you still cannot access the property.
Key Lock Box:
Lock box not unlocking – Ensure you have input the right digits and you have tried to lightly pull open the lock. Please contact us directly if you still cannot access the lock.
Missing Key – The cleaner may be using the key to clean the property at the moment, please contact us directly.
 
Q19. I have arrived but my property is not cleaned yet, what do I do?
A19. Our check-in time is at 4PM. If you have arrived before this time, your property may not be ready yet. Please refer to the “Q2. Luggage Drop Off” section in the FAQ(s).
 
Q20. I am checking out soon, is there anything else I need to do?
A20. If you did not receive a physical key, there is nothing else you need to do, however we would appreciate it greatly if you could let us know when you have checked out as this will help with our cleaning schedule. If you received a physical key, please make sure to return the key to the original location and scramble the code before checking out.
 
Q21. Can I leave unwashed dishes in the sink?
A21. No – The cleaning fee is for the property to be cleaned prior to your stay. If you leave unwashed dishes, you will be charged an extra $50.
 
Q22. Who can I contact for assistance?
A22. Please contact us through the inbox of your booking platform or contact us directly. As we have multiple staff looking after the inbox, you may receive a response faster by leaving us a message through the booking platform’s inbox.
 
Thank you!

publicDescription.summary:
Looking for an affordable place to stay while exploring, studying, or working in Sydney? Got an event nearby and need somewhere comfortable to stay the night? If so, then this guesthouse is perfect for you!
 
Located in Mascot is our beautiful convenient Guesthouse. It is situated in a quiet street within walking distance to the nearest bus station, within 13-minute walk to Domestic airport & Mascot Station.
 
Our place is great for students, solo adventurers, couples or business travellers.
publicDescription.space:
Entrance is from the front door on the ground floor once you have entered through the gate. There is free parking on the street with the limit of 3hours.

Each room or studio is fully renovated with a professional designer, it boasts a stylish quaint twist which brings a very relaxing atmosphere, and we are sure you will love it here! 

THE GUEST HOUSE:
This private boutique guest house is a modern home with a stylish design just 1-minute walk from the closest bus station. It is perfect for students, couples, solo adventurers, business workers, hospital workers or a small group of friends. Here are some details on this beautiful guest house:
- Situated on a quiet street within walking distance to the nearest bus station and local shops & cafés
- 1 Fully furnished Private Bedroom 
- 1 Shared Bathroom
- Separate dining area with Kitchen and Dining table
- Decorated in a Modern Hospitality Style
- Free Wi-Fi throughout the house
- Fans provided during summer // Heating blankets during winter
- Communal areas are cleaned 2x a week

THE BEDROOMS:
1 double bed, bedside table, mirror, closet, study desk, fan. Shared bathroom and kitchen. Sleeps 2 people.

Common spaces include the kitchen/dining area, bathroom, laundry area, the front yard and the outdoor area at the back. 

THE KITCHEN/DINING AREA:
We understand that food is an essential part of every trip, so we have provided a fully equipped kitchen that is always ready if you wish to cook up a storm. There is a fridge, microwave, stove top, oven, kettle, toaster, pots, pans, crockery and a dining tabletop in the kitchen area perfect for any eating needs.

The dining area is the perfect area of the house to go to when you have tasty food to devour. Whether you decide to cook up a storm in our kitchen or order takeaway, there is no better place to eat than the dining area. The dining area has a dining table which can accommodate up to 3 people at a time.

THE BATHROOM:
There is 1 modern communal bathrooms for you, our guests to use. Bathroom comes fully equipped with a shower, essential amenities, basin, drawer, mirror-cabinet, ventilation and a toilet. 

THE LAUNDRY ROOM:
Have you spilt some coffee on your shirt? Or got clothes that need cleaning? Don’t worry! Our laundry room has a large basin, iron, ironing board, cleaning essentials and a washing machine for all your basic cleaning needs. There is also a rotary clothesline in the back yard for you to dry your clothes.

THE OUTDOOR HANGOUT AREA / BACKYARD:
This is the part of the property where guests may go outdoors to have a cigarette, get some fresh air and eat/drink outdoors or just to relax and have some banter. A rotary clothesline is provided for all your drying needs.

Whether you are a backpacker travelling or just looking for a place to stay, our accommodation welcomes you!
-Affordable pricing
-Opportunity to meet new people
-Centrally located to many hotspots with convenient transportation makes exploring easy

GREAT FOR COUPLES:
Perfect for couples whether travelling or just looking for a place to stay after a night out.
-Modern design rooms with a double bed
-Intimate setting

GREAT FOR SMALL GROUPS OF FRIENDS:
The guest house is a great place to host your group trip to Sydney if you book more than 1 room. 
-Close to Mascot CBD, where you can go shopping locally.

GREAT FOR STUDENTS:
This guest house is excellent for students looking to study University, College or TAFE.
-Walking distance to bus station makes public transportation convenient.
-Close to Mascot Station – Walking Distance!

-Close to the heart of Mascot

publicDescription.neighborhood: Mascot is a suburb in the Inner-South of Sydney, in the state of New South Wales, Australia. Mascot is located 7 kilometres south of the Sydney central business district and is one of the administrative centres of the Bayside Council. A small part of Mascot is located in the Inner West Council. Mascot has a mixture of residential, commercial and industrial areas. The main shopping centre is located on Botany Road. The area around Mascot railway station is being redeveloped to contain high-density commercial and residential developments. The Police Headquarters for the local Botany Bay Area Command is on Botany Road and Mascot Ambulance Station is situated directly opposite. Mascot Fire Station is located in Coward Street, beside the City of Botany Bay Council Chambers.

unconfirmedFirstMessage.message:
------This is an automated message, please do not reply------

Dear {{guest_first}}, sorry for the delay, I will be with you as soon as possible! If you don't require a response, please kindly ignore this message.

Please note that our office hours are between 9AM-6PM, Monday – Friday. Delays in response outside of this timeframe and on the weekends may be expected. 

If you have not received a response yet, please check out our frequently asked questions (FAQ) below:

**FAQ - Frequently Asked Questions**

Q1. Can I early check-in or late check-out?
A1. Early check-in requests are subject to the previous day's availability, please contact us on the day of check-in to check availability. Alternatively, you may book 1 day ahead of your check-in date to guarantee an early check-in. Late check-out requests are only available until 11AM if approved, please contact us directly to arrange this.
 
Q2. Luggage Drop Off - Can I drop off my luggage before check-in or store my luggage to collect later after check-out?
A2. This depends on whether you have booked for a private room, or for the whole house. If you have booked for a private room, we have chain-locks available in the common area with keys attached, please feel free to use this if you require luggage storage. If you have booked for a full house, we do not currently have any storage facilities for luggage storage.
 
Q3. Will there be anyone to receive me once I arrive?
A3. No - This is a self-check-in property, we will send you check-in instructions on how to access the property. We only provide online reception.
 
Q4. Where is your property address located?
A4. Please refer to your booking confirmation message or e-mail.
 
Q5. Do you provide parking?
A5. We do not have dedicated parking available unless you have booked for our property in Hurstville. Street parking may be available, please be mindful of parking limits and costs.
 
Q6. Do you offer transport?
A6. No -  We do not offer transport. Please arrange your own transport services.
 
Q7. Do you allow pets at your property?
A7. No – We have a strict no pet policy.
 
Q8. Do you provide clean linen and bath towels?
A8. Yes! We provide these amenities upon arrival free of charge; you just need to bring yourself and your own essential items. For extra linen and towels there will be an additional charge, please contact us to arrange.
 
Q9. Do you do housekeeping?
A9. Yes -  We offer housekeeping but with a charge. The cost will be the same as the cleaning fee, please contact us to arrange.
 
Q10. I may have to change my booking dates. How do I do that?
A10. This depends on which platform you have booked with:
Airbnb - Please go on to your trips page and request for a date alteration, please note that this will be subject to availability. If you are unable to make a request for yourself, please contact us directly and we can check for you.
Bcom - Please contact customer service.
All other platforms and direct bookings - Please contact us directly.
 
Q11. I need to cancel my reservation. Will there be a cancellation fee?
A11. It depends.
If you need to cancel your reservation because we can’t host you, or circumstances relating to our fault, you are eligible for a full refund provided you confirm the booking cancellation. If you do not confirm your cancellation, you will be charged depending on how many days have passed.
If you need to cancel your reservation because of extenuating circumstances, we have a 3-day advanced notice policy for free cancellations. For cancellations within 3-days of check-in, you will be charged the daily rate for each day of delay. Proof of extenuating circumstances will be required.
For all other cancellations, please refer to the cancellation policy you have booked under.
Please note for all booking platforms other than Airbnb and Bcom, there will be a 10% surcharge for all refunds.
 
Q12. How do I cancel my reservation?
A12. This will depend on the platform you have booked with:
Airbnb – Go to your trips page and select cancellation options.
Bcom - Please contact customer service and notify us via the inbox.
All other platforms and direct bookings – Please contact us directly.
 
Q13. I need to extend my booking; how do I do that?
A13. Booking extensions are subject to availability and not guaranteed unless confirmed. For the best chances of extension, please make a request at least 24 hours before check-out. Please refer to the following:
Airbnb – Go to your trips page, request your date change and then notify us via the inbox. If you are unable to put in the request, please contact us via the inbox – Include details with your new dates needed.
Bcom - Please contact customer service on and notify us via the inbox - Include details with your new dates needed.
All other platforms and direct bookings – Please contact us directly and include details with your new dates needed.
 
Q14. I need to shorten my reservation; Will there be a fee? How do I do that?
A14. It depends. We have a 3-day advanced notice policy, if you let us know at least 3-days prior to your new check-out date, we can give you a refund of the remaining nights. If you want to shorten your reservation because of an issue you encounter at our property, please contact us and we may be able to waive the fee. Please refer to the following:
Airbnb – Go to your trips page, request your date change and then notify us via the inbox. If you are unable to put in the request, please contact us via the inbox – Include details with your new dates needed.
Bcom - Please contact customer service on and notify us via the inbox - Include details with your new dates needed.
All other platforms and direct bookings – Please contact us directly and include details with your new dates needed. There will be a 10% processing fee applicable for all refunds.
 
Q15. I have not received my check-in instructions yet. What should I do?
A15. This depends on which platform you have booked with:
Airbnb - Please ensure that it is at least 3-hours prior to our check-in time. If you still have not received it, please contact us via the inbox.
Bcom – Please ensure that you have filled out the check-in form at least 3-hours prior to our check-in time for bookings made more than 1 day in advance, or 30-minutes after booking confirmation for same day bookings. If you still have not received it, please contact us via the inbox.
For all other platforms and direct bookings - Please ensure that you have filled out the check-in form at least 3-hours prior to our check-in time for bookings made more than 1 day in advance, or 30-minutes after booking confirmation for same day bookings. Please ensure your payment is not declined and you do not have payments pending. If you still have not received it, please contact us directly.
 
Q16. I have not received any messages or emails. What should I do? (Excluding Airbnb)
A16. Please check your emails, if you have not received anything or are missing emails from us, please check your spam inbox. Please ensure that your contact details are correct, and if you still have not received anything, please contact us directly.
 
Q17. Access - How to access the property using the code provided?
A17. Please refer to the following:
Smart Lock - Enter the digits provided followed by the ‘#’ or ‘*’ sign. Please note that the numbers will still register even if there is no sound. If there are no numbers on the screen, please lightly tap the screen and the numbers should appear.
Key Lock Box – Input the correct digits and unlock the box to receive the key inside. Once you have access to the key, close the lock box and scramble the code. Please make sure to return the key at check-out.
 
Q18. I followed the check-in instructions, but I still cannot access the property. What should I do?
A18. Please refer to the following.
Smart Lock:
Verification failed – Please contact us directly.
Lock alarm going off – Please wait for at least 5-minutes after the alarm stops and try again.
Nothing happens when I enter the code – Please move the door in and out and try again, the door might have jammed. Refer to the “Q17. Access” section in the FAQ(s), please contact us directly if you still cannot access the property.
Key Lock Box:
Lock box not unlocking – Ensure you have input the right digits and you have tried to lightly pull open the lock. Please contact us directly if you still cannot access the lock.
Missing Key – The cleaner may be using the key to clean the property at the moment, please contact us directly.
 
Q19. I have arrived but my property is not cleaned yet, what do I do?
A19. Our check-in time is at 4PM. If you have arrived before this time, your property may not be ready yet. Please refer to the “Q2. Luggage Drop Off” section in the FAQ(s).
 
Q20. I am checking out soon, is there anything else I need to do?
A20. If you did not receive a physical key, there is nothing else you need to do, however we would appreciate it greatly if you could let us know when you have checked out as this will help with our cleaning schedule. If you received a physical key, please make sure to return the key to the original location and scramble the code before checking out.
 
Q21. Can I leave unwashed dishes in the sink?
A21. No – The cleaning fee is for the property to be cleaned prior to your stay. If you leave unwashed dishes, you will be charged an extra $50.
 
Q22. Who can I contact for assistance?
A22. Please contact us through the inbox of your booking platform or contact us directly. As we have multiple staff looking after the inbox, you may receive a response faster by leaving us a message through the booking platform’s inbox.
 
Thank you!

publicDescription.summary:
Looking for an affordable place to stay while exploring, studying, or working in Sydney? Got an event nearby and need somewhere comfortable to stay the night? If so, then this guesthouse is perfect for you!
 
Located in Mascot is our beautiful convenient Guesthouse. It is situated in a quiet street within walking distance to the nearest bus station, within 13-minute walk to Domestic airport & Mascot Station.
 
Our place is great for students, solo adventurers, couples or business travellers.
publicDescription.space:
Entrance is from the front door on the ground floor once you have entered through the gate. There is free parking on the street with the limit of 3hours.

Each room or studio is fully renovated with a professional designer, it boasts a stylish quaint twist which brings a very relaxing atmosphere, and we are sure you will love it here! 

THE GUEST HOUSE:
This private boutique guest house is a modern home with a stylish design just 1-minute walk from the closest bus station. It is perfect for students, couples, solo adventurers, business workers, hospital workers or a small group of friends. Here are some details on this beautiful guest house:
- Situated on a quiet street within walking distance to the nearest bus station and local shops & cafés
- 1 Fully furnished Private Bedroom 
- 1 Shared Bathroom
- Separate dining area with Kitchen and Dining table
- Decorated in a Modern Hospitality Style
- Free Wi-Fi throughout the house
- Fans provided during summer // Heating blankets during winter
- Communal areas are cleaned 2x a week

THE BEDROOMS:
1 double bed, bedside table, mirror, closet, study desk, fan. Shared bathroom and kitchen. Sleeps 2 people.

Common spaces include the kitchen/dining area, bathroom, laundry area, the front yard and the outdoor area at the back. 

THE KITCHEN/DINING AREA:
We understand that food is an essential part of every trip, so we have provided a fully equipped kitchen that is always ready if you wish to cook up a storm. There is a fridge, microwave, stove top, oven, kettle, toaster, pots, pans, crockery and a dining tabletop in the kitchen area perfect for any eating needs.

The dining area is the perfect area of the house to go to when you have tasty food to devour. Whether you decide to cook up a storm in our kitchen or order takeaway, there is no better place to eat than the dining area. The dining area has a dining table which can accommodate up to 3 people at a time.

THE BATHROOM:
There is 1 modern communal bathrooms for you, our guests to use. Bathroom comes fully equipped with a shower, essential amenities, basin, drawer, mirror-cabinet, ventilation and a toilet. 

THE LAUNDRY ROOM:
Have you spilt some coffee on your shirt? Or got clothes that need cleaning? Don’t worry! Our laundry room has a large basin, iron, ironing board, cleaning essentials and a washing machine for all your basic cleaning needs. There is also a rotary clothesline in the back yard for you to dry your clothes.

THE OUTDOOR HANGOUT AREA / BACKYARD:
This is the part of the property where guests may go outdoors to have a cigarette, get some fresh air and eat/drink outdoors or just to relax and have some banter. A rotary clothesline is provided for all your drying needs.

Whether you are a backpacker travelling or just looking for a place to stay, our accommodation welcomes you!
-Affordable pricing
-Opportunity to meet new people
-Centrally located to many hotspots with convenient transportation makes exploring easy

GREAT FOR COUPLES:
Perfect for couples whether travelling or just looking for a place to stay after a night out.
-Modern design rooms with a double bed
-Intimate setting

GREAT FOR SMALL GROUPS OF FRIENDS:
The guest house is a great place to host your group trip to Sydney if you book more than 1 room. 
-Close to Mascot CBD, where you can go shopping locally.

GREAT FOR STUDENTS:
This guest house is excellent for students looking to study University, College or TAFE.
-Walking distance to bus station makes public transportation convenient.
